kind: engineering acceptance contract, not a blinded model benchmark
scope: initial read-only continuation; no automatic write-stage or failed-task restart

cases.expect: Fork a single retained session; original message/part content unchanged; prior conversation preserved; same candidate verified; no writes or publishing.
Reject a closed task, changed task body or withdrawn authorization before invoking any model.
Reject a changed base commit, candidate patch, protected-path policy or trusted Git metadata receipt; never infer sameness from a directory name.
Old diagnostic-only profiles, including failed run33, are not resumable without a controller-authored task/base/candidate binding. Preserve old results.
Reject multiple possible sessions, corrupt database, missing receipts or incompatible harness/version; retain evidence.
Reject profile/candidate paths outside the approved controller root and symlink substitutions before reading payload or starting a model.
Resume read-only with original explicit tool denials, no GitHub/App credentials, no shell or project hooks/plugins; pending write tools must not run.
Keep provider parks, repair allowances, cumulative usage and all failed attempts; record continuation separately with an explicit parent reference.
Refuse concurrent continuation; acquire a new owned lease and preserve the source lease/result.
Recheck candidate and task before any publication; a resumed review alone cannot publish or approve a merge.
A separate actual-provider experiment must demonstrate useful continuation of an interrupted response; synthetic completed-conversation evidence is insufficient.

privacy: Raw real prompts/reasoning/tool payloads stay private; public evidence uses bounded metadata/hashes.
quality: Do not shorten thinking or weaken acceptance to make a continuation pass.
